message: I feel really overwhelmed and exhausted today.
notes: Distress self-report should stay supportive and avoid jumping into exercises.
Short self-report should not be routed to clarifying.

message: Why do I keep ending up in the same fight with my partner?
notes: Reflective mode should probe gently and usually ask a question.

message: I notice I keep apologizing first even when I'm hurt.

notes: Sparse input should elicit one focused clarifying question.
Explicit confusion marker should route to clarifying.

message: Hi, what can you do for me?
notes: Session-opening capability ask should feel warm/supportive rather than interrogative.

message: I'm spiraling and I can't think straight. Please don't give me techniques right now.
notes: Readiness-sensitive case: should avoid structured interventions when user declines.

message: My heart races and my chest gets tight at night. Why does this happen?
notes: Concrete reaction + understanding request should route to psychoeducation.

message: Can you guide me through a grounding exercise right now?
notes: Explicit intervention request should route to guided_exercise.

message: Can you help me examine this thought step by step? I want to look at evidence for and against it.
notes: Structured thought-work request should route to technique style.

message: Thanks, I need to head out now. Let's pause here.
notes: Explicit wind-down should route to closing style.
